All company leaders must have competence in engagement science, collections knowledge and other key tenets of our industry. The degree to which a company leader will need to immerse themselves will be dependent on position and seniority, but as a minimum, leaders must be fully conversant with the company’s overall strategy, product, and client base. Company leaders should actively contribute to the development of thought leadership, by joining the debate and commenting, and sharing their experiences to inform the lessons learned process. A few examples of how this can be achieved are by joining industry panels, authoring articles, delivering training sessions and contributing to the company’s blog.
